content.title: Caleres Q3 profit plunges on margin pressure
content.summary: American footwear company Caleres has reported higher third-quarter (Q3) sales but a steep drop in profitability, as margin pressure, higher operating expenses and dilution from its Stuart Weitzman acquisition offset strength in its core brands.
